description_short: Adds Lead-acid and Lithium-ion battery production chains using existing game resources.
description_long:
Adds two battery production chains using existing game resources:

Lead-acid: unlocked near Sulfur Processing research. Lead is recovered from copper scrap in an acid bath (Chemical Plant), then combined with Acid and Plastic in an Assembler to produce Lead-acid batteries.

Lithium-ion: unlocked after Robotic Assembly research. Lithium is extracted from Brine in the Tier-2 Electrolyzer (with a Salt by-product), then assembled with Copper, Plastic and Electronics in the Robotic Assembler.

Batteries integrate as consumer electronics via alternate recipes: feeding batteries into the standard Consumer Electronics line lets settlements consume them through the existing demand.

Note: a dedicated 'battery power-storage building' and a new 'battery-consuming maintenance type' are intentionally NOT included — those require extending the CustomAssets C# framework (new static-entity / new maintenance-type builders), which is beyond a Python recipe pack.
